source.compiler: Daniel Kowalsky, Stalin and the Spanish Civil War (2004), Chapter 14, Tables V-4 through V-7, based on Soviet RGVA files and Rybalkin
source.originalProvenance: Russian State Military Archive (RGVA) wartime reporting; individual file references are in the source's numbered footnotes 48-51
source.reliabilityCaution: Soviet reports of Nationalist losses are NOT verified Nationalist aircraft incidents. Their reported 572 air-combat victories are considered inflated by later historians; treat them as Soviet-side claims/estimates, not actual enemy losses.

crossSideReportedLossComparisonTableV4.meaning: Counts in Soviet RGVA reports. Nationalist observations are Soviet assertions/claims, not independent actual losses; Republican observations are Soviet-side loss records, with scope uncertain.

republicanAircraftLossByTypeAndCauseTabl.meaning: Republican aircraft losses present in RGVA/Rybalkin compiled lists, not necessarily a census of all Republican-built or privately operated aircraft; includes Soviet-derived types and limited others.

sovietPilotsByAircraftTypeAndYearTableV6.meaning: Soviet pilots serving Republican aviation by aircraft type/year as described in the RGVA/Rybalkin material; NOT necessarily unique persons across years or a year-end staffing count.
sovietPilotsByAircraftTypeAndYearTableV6.dashSemantics: Printed em dashes retained as null rather than asserted numerical zero.

sovietPilotFatalitiesAndMissingTableV7.printedHeadingSays: 1936-1939; source columns end 1938; do not infer 1939 zero
sovietPilotFatalitiesAndMissingTableV7.meaning: Death and missing status among Soviet pilots serving Spain, not all Republican aircrew or Spanish nationals; missing should not automatically be recorded as died.

validationStatus: Digitally retyped from an indexed scholarly PDF excerpt; cross-recheck original Table V-5/6/7 images before publication. All printed row/column arithmetic is testable.
